name: GitHub
description: Public GitHub repositories: a project's latest releases, and its open issues on a subject. Shows path parameters ({owner}/{repo}) and Link-header pagination. Works without a token at 60 requests an hour; for private repositories or more, set the auth to bearer and give it a token in Connection.

operations.summary: A repository's latest releases, newest first.
operations.ask_when: the question names a GitHub repository (owner/name) and asks about its latest release, version or changelog.

response.empty: That repository has no releases (it may publish tags only).

operations.summary: Open issues in a repository that mention a subject.
operations.ask_when: the question names a GitHub repository (owner/name) and asks about open issues, bugs or known problems with something.

query.description: repo and words, e.g. repo:astral-sh/uv is:issue is:open docker
